blocks.explanation:
Yahan cosine minus sine hai. Is exercise ke formulas tab lagte hain jab dono ratios ek hi qisam ke hon (dono sine ya dono cosine).
Saabit kya karna hai? Farq \(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
Plan: \(\sin 15^{\circ}\) ko \(\cos 75^{\circ}\) likh dein, phir \(\cos P - \cos Q\) formula lagayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: L.H.S. \(= \cos 15^{\circ} - \sin 15^{\circ}\).
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
Tareeqa: \(\sin\theta = \cos(90^{\circ} - \theta)\), phir
\[\cos P - \cos Q\]
\[= -2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]

Dono ko cosine banayein
\[\sin 15^{\circ} = \cos(90^{\circ} - 15^{\circ}) = \cos 75^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \cos 15^{\circ} - \cos 75^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Complementary angles (jin ka jama \(90^{\circ}\) ho) mein ek ka sine doosre ka cosine hota hai. Is tarah dono ratios ek jaise ho gaye.

Formula lagayein (\(P = 15^{\circ}\), \(Q = 75^{\circ}\))
\[= -2\sin 45^{\circ}\sin(-30^{\circ})\]
\[= 2\sin 45^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Aadha jama \(\frac{90^{\circ}}{2} = 45^{\circ}\), aadha farq \(\frac{15^{\circ} - 75^{\circ}}{2} = -30^{\circ}\). \(\sin(-30^{\circ}) = -\sin 30^{\circ}\), aur do minus mil kar plus.
Dhyan dein: Order \(P = 15^{\circ}\), \(Q = 75^{\circ}\) hi rakhein jaisa sawal mein hai; ulta karne se sign ghalat ho sakta hai.

Values rakhein
\[= 2\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\sin 45^{\circ} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) aur \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\); 2 aur \(\frac{1}{2}\) cancel.

Tasdeeq
\[\cos 15^{\circ} - \sin 15^{\circ} \approx 0.9659 - 0.2588\]
\[= 0.7071 \approx \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \approx 0.7071\). Doosra tareeqa: Question 6 ka \(\sin 15^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{2\sqrt{2}}\) aur \(\cos 15^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{2\sqrt{2}}\) ka farq bhi \(\frac{2}{2\sqrt{2}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) deta hai.
